{"task":{"id":"Prob078_dualedge","spec":"
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  d
 - output q

A dual-edge triggered flip-flop is triggered on both edges of the clock.
However, FPGAs don't have dual-edge triggered flip-flops, and using an
always @(posedge clk or negedge clk) is not accepted as a legal
sensitivity list. Build a circuit that functionally behaves like a
dual-edge triggered flip-flop.

","interface":{"top":"TopModule","ports":[{"name":"clk","direction":"input","width":1,"signed":false},{"name":"d","direction":"input","width":1,"signed":false},{"name":"q","direction":"output","width":1,"signed":false}]},"constraints":"SystemVerilog, exactly one self-contained TopModule DUT. Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI."},"current":{"revision_id":"6faed42c-8e6b-47b1-8793-79908a7b244a","source_sha256":"e1b4de135865ed2b6e2219b1c91f774c81ef3d2c2bca49d05a4f3050530db083","source":"
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  d,
    output q
);

    reg q_pos;
    reg q_neg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        q_pos <= d;
    end

    always @(negedge clk) begin
        q_neg <= d;
    end

    assign q = clk ? q_pos : q_neg;

endmodule

function.name: edit_dut
function.description: Replace only the current single DUT. Supply its expected revision. Does not run verification.

function.name: verify_rtl
function.description: Verify the current revision with its registered test suite through compilation, elaboration, simulation and synthesis.

function.name: read_current_rtl
function.description: Read the current DUT and verification state.

function.name: retrieve_skill
function.description: Retrieve at most two applicable validated rules. Disabled in groups A and B.

function.name: finish
function.description: Stop without claiming an unverified design passed.
